text:
emily: Tiny PSA  There's a half-open box of biscotti in the microwave and it's somehow gone crunchy in the worst way. Who microwaved dry baked goods? :confused:
rafael: Not me. But I did heat up leftover curry last night and the microwave splashed everywhere 
priya: Ugh curry splatter is the worst. Can we put a quick 'microwave etiquette' sticky on the door? Cover your food + wipe if you make a mess.
emily: Yes please. Also can someone check the cream cheese tub in the fridge? Found a spoon in it with no name and it's been... evolving. :sweat_smile:
pantry-bot: Reminder created: "Label your shared containers". Suggested supplies: disposable food covers, microwave-safe lids, microfiber wipes. React with :+1: to approve purchase.
rafael: +1 for lids and wipes. Also, maybe a clear bin labeled "community snacks" so people know what's fair game vs. owned items.
priya: Love the bin idea. We should also add a small sign: "If it has a name, it's not free". Simple.
ops-bot: Facilities cleaned microwave at 11:04. Last cleaned log: 2025-03-18T11:04Z. If further issues occur, open a ticket with #kitchen-ops.
emily: Thanks ops! I'll bring a small stack of sticky name tags and a black marker at 2pm. Anyone want salted chocolate chip cookies in return? :cookie:
rafael: I volunteer as tribute for cookies. Also seconding the bin; I can label it "Community - please take one portion"
priya: Can someone check the hummus in the top shelf? It smells a bit off but might be fine. If it's older than 5 days let's toss it.
emily: It's mine, I made it Monday. I'll toss the rest to be safe. Sorry team. :grimacing:
pantry-bot: Quick checklist posted:
```
- microwave lids x2
- microfiber wipes x1 pack
- sticky name tags x1 pack
- small clear bin (community snacks)
- marker
```
